sentences.zh: 父玉，東頭供奉官，言懷德可試引弓、擊劍、角觝，補三班奉職，為延州南安砦主、東路巡檢。

translations.literal: His father Yu was an Eastern Head Palace Attendant; he said Huaide could be tested in drawing the bow, swordplay, and wrestling; he was appointed Third Class attendant, and served as master of Nan'an Stockade at Yanzhou and eastern-route patrol inspector.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yu was an Eastern Head Palace Attendant who recommended that Huaide be tested in archery, swordsmanship, and wrestling. He was appointed a Third Class attendant and served as master of Nan'an Stockade at Yanzhou and eastern-route patrol inspector.

sentences.zh: 數以少擊西賊，敗其眾。

translations.literal: Repeatedly with few men he struck the western bandits and defeated their forces.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly he defeated western enemy forces with only a small detachment.

sentences.zh: 范仲淹知延州，修青澗城，奏懷德為兵馬監押，以所部兵入賊境，破遮鹿、要冊二砦，親射殺其酋狗兒廂主，遷左班殿直。

translations.literal: Fan Zhongyan governed Yanzhou and repaired Qingjian city; he memorialized Huaide as military supervisor; with his command he entered enemy territory, broke Zhelu and Yaoche stockades, personally shot and killed their chieftain Gou'erxiangzhu, and was transferred to Left Class Palace Attendant Direct.
translations.idiomatic: When Fan Zhongyan governed Yanzhou and repaired Qingjian city, he recommended Huaide as military supervisor. Huaide led his troops into enemy territory, captured Zhelu and Yaoche stockades, and personally shot dead the enemy chieftain Gou'erxiangzhu. He was promoted to Left Class Palace Attendant Direct.

sentences.zh: 又率蕃漢燒蕩賊海溝、茶山、龍柏、安化十七砦三百餘帳，斬首數百級，虜馬駝牛羊萬數，遷右侍禁。

translations.literal: Again he led Qiang and Han to burn and ravage seventeen stockades at Haigou, Chashan, Longbai, and Anhua—more than three hundred tents—beheading several hundred, capturing tens of thousands of enemy horses, camels, cattle, and sheep; he was transferred to Right Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He again led Qiang and Han forces to burn and destroy seventeen enemy stockades at Haigou, Chashan, Longbai, and Anhua—more than three hundred tents in all—taking several hundred heads and tens of thousands of horses, camels, cattle, and sheep. He was promoted to Right Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 以范仲淹、韓琦薦，授閣門祗候，延州龐籍入奏為東路都巡檢使。

translations.literal: On recommendation of Fan Zhongyan and Han Qi he was appointed gatekeeper attendant; Pang Ji of Yanzhou entered court and memorialized him as overall eastern-route inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On the recommendation of Fan Zhongyan and Han Qi he was made gatekeeper attendant. Pang Ji of Yanzhou memorialized at court to appoint him overall inspector of the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 夷黑神、厥保等十八砦，賊以四萬騎犯邊，趨僕射穀。

translations.literal: At the eighteen stockades of Yiheishen, Juebao, and others, the bandits with forty thousand horsemen invaded the border and pressed toward Pushe Valley.
translations.idiomatic: At the eighteen stockades including Yiheishen and Juebao, the enemy invaded the frontier with forty thousand horsemen and advanced on Pushe Valley.

sentences.zh: 懷德以兵數千據穀旁高原待之，斬首二百級，得畜產、器械以千數。

translations.literal: Huaide with several thousand troops held the high ground beside the valley to await them, beheading two hundred, and obtaining livestock and weapons numbering in the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Huaide with several thousand men held the high ground beside the valley and awaited them, taking two hundred heads and capturing thousands of livestock and weapons.

sentences.zh: 遷內殿崇班。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Inner Hall Honored Company.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Inner Hall Honored Company.

sentences.zh: 又以兵修龍安城，虜不敢犯，遂為鄜延路都監。

translations.literal: Again with troops he repaired Long'an city; the barbarians did not dare offend, and he then became overall supervisor of the Fuyan route.
translations.idiomatic: He again led troops to repair Long'an city, and the enemy did not dare attack. He was then made overall supervisor of the Fuyan circuit.

sentences.zh: 又城綏平，破賊青化、押班、吃當三砦，殺獲甚眾。

translations.literal: He also fortified Suiping, broke the three enemy stockades Qinghua, Yaban, and Chidang, and killed or captured very many.
translations.idiomatic: He also fortified Suiping and captured the three enemy stockades of Qinghua, Yaban, and Chidang, killing and capturing a great many of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 元昊為夏國主，命國子博士高良夫與懷德會西人畫界。

translations.literal: When Yuanhao became lord of the Xia state, he ordered Erudite of the Imperial Academy Gao Liangfu to meet with Huaide and the westerners to draw the border.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanhao became ruler of the Xia state, he ordered Erudite of the Imperial Academy Gao Liangfu to meet with Huaide and the western tribes to demarcate the border.

sentences.zh: 龐籍具論其前後功，遷供備庫副使兼閣門通事舍人。

translations.literal: Pang Ji set forth in full his merits before and after; he was transferred to vice commissioner of the supply depot and concurrently Communications Envoy of the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Ji detailed his achievements over the years, and he was promoted to vice commissioner of the supply depot and concurrently Communications Envoy of the gate.

sentences.zh: 時用兵久，民多亡散，懷德招輯有方，經略使梁適奏請推其法諸路。

translations.literal: At the time troops had been used for long; the people mostly fled and scattered; Huaide had effective methods for gathering and settling them; frontier commissioner Liang Shi memorialized requesting his methods be extended to all routes.
translations.idiomatic: The war had dragged on and many people had fled or been scattered. Huaide had effective methods for resettling them, and frontier commissioner Liang Shi petitioned to extend his methods to all circuits.

sentences.zh: 曆知保安軍、環州、環慶益利路鈐轄，累遷至四方館使、舒州團練使，徙鄜延路副都總管。

translations.literal: He successively governed Bao'an Army, Huanzhou, and military commissioner of Huanqing-Yili route; through successive promotions reached commissioner of the Four Directions Hall and regimental commissioner of Shuzhou; was transferred to vice overall commander of Fuyan route.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as prefect of Bao'an Army and Huanzhou and as military commissioner of the Huanqing-Yili circuit, rose to commissioner of the Four Directions Hall and regimental commissioner of Shuzhou, and was transferred to vice overall commander of the Fuyan circuit.

sentences.zh: 坐違法賂宦官閻士良，為安撫呂景初奏，降四方館使、英州刺史。

translations.literal: He was punished for unlawfully bribing the eunuch Yan Shiliang; pacification commissioner Lü Jingchu memorialized against him; he was demoted to commissioner of the Four Directions Hall and prefect of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished for illegally bribing the eunuch Yan Shiliang. Pacification commissioner Lü Jingchu memorialized against him, and he was demoted to commissioner of the Four Directions Hall and prefect of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 大名府路總管，侍衛親軍步軍都虞候、象州防禦使、鄜延路副都總管，遷馬軍都虞候，徙環慶路。

translations.literal: Overall commander of Daming Prefecture route, chief military adjutant of the Imperial Guard Foot Soldiers, defense commissioner of Xiangzhou, vice overall commander of Fuyan route; promoted to chief military adjutant of the Cavalry; transferred to Huanqing route.
translations.idiomatic: He served as overall commander of the Daming Prefecture circuit, chief military adjutant of the Imperial Guard Foot Soldiers, defense commissioner of Xiangzhou, and vice overall commander of the Fuyan circuit, was promoted to chief military adjutant of the Cavalry, and transferred to the Huanqing circuit.

sentences.zh: 環州蕃官蘇恩以其屬叛，往降之。

translations.literal: The Qiang official Su En of Huanzhou rebelled with his followers; Huaide went to subdue him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qiang official Su En of Huanzhou rebelled with his followers, Huaide went to bring him back to submission.

sentences.zh: 又遷殿前都虞候、步軍副指揮使、隨州觀察使。

translations.literal: Again he was transferred to chief military adjutant of the Palace Front, vice commander of the Foot Soldiers, and observation commissioner of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made chief military adjutant of the Palace Front Division, vice commander of the Foot Soldiers, and observation commissioner of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 英宗即位，遷靜難軍節度觀察留後，召還，卒，贈安遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yingzong took the throne, he was transferred to regent military governor and observer of Jingnan Army; recalled to court; died; posthumously given military governor of Anyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong took the throne, he was made regent military governor of the Jingnan army, recalled to court, and died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as military governor of the Anyuan army.

sentences.zh: 嘗因戰，流矢中其顙，鏃入於骨，以弩弦係鏃，發機而出之。

translations.literal: Once in battle a stray arrow struck his forehead; the arrowhead entered the bone; he tied the arrowhead with a crossbow string, released the mechanism, and drew it out.
translations.idiomatic: Once in battle a stray arrow struck his forehead and the head lodged in the bone. He looped a crossbow string around the head, drew the bow, and pulled the arrow out.

sentences.zh: 安俊，字智周，其先太原人。

translations.literal: An Jun, style name Zhizhou; his ancestors were natives of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: An Jun, whose style name was Zhizhou, was descended from a Taiyuan family.

sentences.zh: 祖贇，高州團練使。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yun was regimental commissioner of Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yun had been regimental commissioner of Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 仁宗為皇太子，俊以將家子謹厚，選為資善堂祗候。

translations.literal: When Renzong was crown prince, Jun as a general's son was careful and honest and was selected as attendant of the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong was crown prince, Jun, the careful and upright son of a military family, was chosen as attendant of the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.

sentences.zh: 及即位，補右班殿直，累遷東頭供奉官、閣門祗候，為環州都監。

translations.literal: When the Emperor took the throne, he was appointed Right Class Palace Attendant Direct; through successive promotions he became Eastern Head Palace Attendant and gatekeeper attendant, and served as overall supervisor of Huanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor's accession he was made Right Class Palace Attendant Direct and rose through successive promotions to Eastern Head Palace Attendant and gatekeeper attendant, then served as overall supervisor of Huanzhou.

sentences.zh: 破趙元昊吃江、井那等諸砦，安撫使韓琦上其功，遷內殿崇班、環慶路都監，徙涇原。

translations.literal: He broke the stockades of Zhao Yuanhao at Chijiang, Jingna, and others; pacification commissioner Han Qi reported his merit; he was transferred to Inner Hall Honored Company and overall supervisor of Huanqing route, then moved to Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He captured the stockades of Zhao Yuanhao at Chijiang, Jingna, and elsewhere. Pacification commissioner Han Qi reported his achievements, and he was promoted to Inner Hall Honored Company and overall supervisor of the Huanqing circuit, then transferred to Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 契丹欲渝盟，與狄青、范恪同召至京師，將使備北邊，擢內園副使。

translations.literal: When the Khitan wished to break the alliance, he was summoned to the capital together with Di Qing and Fan Ke to prepare the northern border; he was promoted to vice commissioner of the Inner Garden.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan threatened to break the alliance, he was summoned to the capital together with Di Qing and Fan Ke to prepare the northern frontier and was promoted to vice commissioner of the Inner Garden.

sentences.zh: 翌日，改禮賓使。

translations.literal: The next day he was changed to Communications Envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The following day he was made Communications Envoy.

sentences.zh: 會葛懷敏敗，命為秦鳳路鈐轄，復徙涇原。

translations.literal: It happened that Ge Huaimin was defeated; he was appointed military commissioner of Qinfeng route, then again transferred to Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Ge Huaimin was defeated, he was appointed military commissioner of the Qinfeng circuit and then transferred again to Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 因條上御戎十三事，改原州，徙麟州，遷六宅使、貴州刺史、知忻州，徙代州。

translations.literal: He thereupon submitted in items thirteen matters for defending against barbarians; was changed to Yuanzhou, transferred to Linzhou, promoted to commissioner of the Six Residences, prefect of Guizhou, and governor of Xinzhou; moved to Daizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted thirteen recommendations on frontier defense, was reassigned to Yuanzhou, transferred to Linzhou, promoted to commissioner of the Six Residences, prefect of Guizhou, and governor of Xinzhou, and then moved to Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 為帥臣誣奏，降京東路鈐轄。

translations.literal: Because a frontier commander falsely memorialized against him, he was demoted to military commissioner of the eastern capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: A frontier commander falsely memorialized against him, and he was demoted to military commissioner of the eastern capital circuit.

sentences.zh: 富弼知青州，為之辨理，真除虢州刺史，徙高陽關路，又遷原州刺史，知滄、涇、冀三州。

translations.literal: Fu Bi governed Qingzhou and argued his case for him; he was truly appointed prefect of Guozhou; transferred to Gaoyang Pass route; again promoted to prefect of Yuanzhou; governed Cang, Jing, and Ji prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Bi, then prefect of Qingzhou, argued his case, and he was formally appointed prefect of Guozhou. He was transferred to the Gaoyang Pass circuit, then made prefect of Yuanzhou and put in charge of Cang, Jing, and Ji prefectures.

sentences.zh: 秦州築古渭城，蕃部大擾，徙秦鳳路總管。

translations.literal: When Qinzhou built Guwei city, the tribal departments were greatly disturbed; he was transferred to overall commander of Qinfeng route.
translations.idiomatic: When Guwei city was built at Qinzhou and the tribal peoples were greatly disturbed, he was transferred to overall commander of the Qinfeng circuit.

sentences.zh: 曆龍神衛、捧日、天武四廂都指揮使，果州團練使，環慶路副總管；

translations.literal: He successively served as overall commander of the four wings of the Dragon Spirit, Sun-Bearer, and Heavenly Martial guards, regimental commissioner of Guozhou, and vice overall commander of Huanqing route;
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as overall commander of the four wings of the Dragon Spirit, Sun-Bearer, and Heavenly Martial guards, as regimental commissioner of Guozhou, and as vice overall commander of the Huanqing circuit;

sentences.zh: 遷侍衛步軍都虞候、陵州防禦使。

translations.literal: he was transferred to chief military adjutant of the Imperial Guard Foot Soldiers and defense commissioner of Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: then was made chief military adjutant of the Imperial Guard Foot Soldiers and defense commissioner of Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈閬州觀察使。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously given observation commissioner of Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously enfeoffed as observation commissioner of Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 俊久在邊，羌人識之。

translations.literal: Jun was long on the frontier; the Qiang knew him.
translations.idiomatic: Jun had long served on the frontier, and the Qiang knew him well.

sentences.zh: 環州得俘虜，知州種世衡問之曰：「若屬於吾將孰畏？

translations.literal: When Huanzhou obtained captives, prefect Zhong Shihang asked them: "Among our generals, whom do you fear?
translations.idiomatic: When Huanzhou took captives, prefect Zhong Shihang asked them, "Among our generals, whom do you fear?

sentences.zh: 」曰：「畏安大保。

translations.literal: " They said: "We fear Grand Guardian An.
translations.idiomatic: They answered, "We fear Grand Guardian An.

sentences.zh: 」指俊於坐曰：「此長髯將軍是也。」

translations.literal: " Pointing to Jun in the assembly they said: "This is the long-bearded general."
translations.idiomatic: " Pointing to Jun among those present, they said, "That long-bearded general is the one."

sentences.zh: 向寶，鎮戎軍人，為御前忠佐，換禮賓使，涇原、秦鳳鈐轄。

translations.literal: Xiang Bao, a man of Zhenrong Army, served as loyal aide before the throne, exchanged to Communications Envoy, and military commissioner of Jingyuan and Qinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Bao, a native of Zhenrong Army, served as a loyal aide before the throne, was transferred to Communications Envoy, and served as military commissioner of Jingyuan and Qinfeng.

sentences.zh: 積勞，自皇城使帶禦器械，曆真定、鄜延副總管，遷龍神衛四廂都指揮使、嘉州團練使，卒。

translations.literal: Through accumulated labor he rose from imperial city commissioner bearing imperial weapons; successively served as vice overall commander of Zhending and Fuyan; was transferred to overall commander of the four wings of the Dragon Spirit Guard and regimental commissioner of Jiazhou; died.
translations.idiomatic: Through long service he rose from imperial city commissioner bearing imperial weapons to vice overall commander of Zhending and Fuyan, then to overall commander of the four wings of the Dragon Spirit Guard and regimental commissioner of Jiazhou, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 寶善騎射，年十四，與敵戰，斬首二級。

translations.literal: Bao was skilled in mounted archery; at age fourteen he fought the enemy and beheaded two.
translations.idiomatic: Bao was skilled in horsemanship and archery. At fourteen he fought the enemy and took two heads.

sentences.zh: 及壯，以勇聞。

translations.literal: When he reached maturity he was famed for courage.
translations.idiomatic: When he grew to manhood he was famed for his courage.

sentences.zh: 有虎踞五原卑邪州，東西百里斷人跡，寶一矢殪之。

translations.literal: A tiger crouched at Wuyuan in Beixie Prefecture; for a hundred li east and west it cut off human tracks; Bao with one arrow killed it.
translations.idiomatic: A tiger at Wuyuan in Beixie Prefecture had blocked travelers for a hundred li east and west. Bao brought it down with a single arrow.

sentences.zh: 道過潼關，巨盜郭邈山多載關中金帛、子女，寶射走之，盡得其所掠。

translations.literal: Passing Tong Pass, the great bandit Guo Miaoshan carried much gold, silks, and women from within the pass; Bao shot and drove him off and recovered all that he had plundered.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Tong Pass, he encountered the great bandit Guo Miaoshan, who was carrying away gold, silks, and captives from within the pass. Bao shot at him and drove him off, recovering everything that had been plundered.

sentences.zh: 嘗至太原，梁適射弩再中的，授寶矢射之，四發三中。

translations.literal: He once came to Taiyuan; Liang Shi shot the crossbow and twice hit the mark; he gave Bao arrows to shoot; four shots, three hits.
translations.idiomatic: Once at Taiyuan, Liang Shi shot a crossbow and hit the target twice. He handed Bao his arrows; Bao fired four times and hit three times.

sentences.zh: 適曰：「今之飛將也。

translations.literal: Shi said: "A flying general of our age.
translations.idiomatic: Shi said, "A flying general of our age!

sentences.zh: 」神宗稱其勇，以比薛仁貴。

translations.literal: " Emperor Shenzong praised his courage and compared him to Xue Rengui.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong praised his courage and compared him to Xue Rengui.

sentences.zh: 及死，厚恤其家。

translations.literal: When he died, his family was generously compensated.
translations.idiomatic: When he died, his family received generous compensation.

sentences.zh: 論曰：蔚昭敏、高化、周美，蓋皆有功於邊鄙者。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Yu Zhaomin, Gao Hua, and Zhou Mei were all men who had merit on the remote frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Yu Zhaomin, Gao Hua, and Zhou Mei were all men who had served the frontier with distinction.

sentences.zh: 化在蜀州，取軍中積材以塞水患，又能平反冤獄，脫人於死，蓋武人之知民事者。

translations.literal: When Hua was at Shuzhou, he took accumulated materials in the army to block flood harm, and could also reverse unjust cases and release people from death—he was a martial man who understood civilian affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At Shuzhou, Hua used accumulated army timber to stem flooding, and he also reversed wrongful convictions and saved men from execution—a warrior who understood civilian affairs.

sentences.zh: 美敗夏人，焚族部，城堡砦，未嘗擇便利，而所向輒勝；

translations.literal: Mei defeated the Xia people, burned tribal encampments, castles and stockades, never chose what was convenient, yet wherever he went he invariably prevailed;
translations.idiomatic: Mei defeated the Xia, burned tribal settlements and forts, never chose the easy assignment, yet prevailed wherever he went;

sentences.zh: 所得祿賜，悉分與麾下，士亦樂為之用，推古良將，何以加此。

translations.literal: the salary and gifts he obtained he entirely divided among his subordinates; the soldiers also gladly served under him—set against ancient good generals, how could one add to this?
translations.idiomatic: he gave all his salary and rewards to his men, who gladly followed him. Compared with the great generals of antiquity, what more could be asked?

sentences.zh: 閻守恭慕郭進為人，而慷慨自效，起徒步至刺史，其志亦豈小哉。

translations.literal: Yan Shougong admired Guo Jin as a man and generously devoted himself; rising on foot to prefect—his ambition was surely no small thing.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shougong admired Guo Jin and devoted himself generously. Rising from the ranks to prefect, his ambition was surely no small thing.

sentences.zh: 孟元、劉謙、馬懷德、范恪皆經略西鄙，數戰有功。

translations.literal: Meng Yuan, Liu Qian, Ma Huaide, and Fan Ke all managed the western frontier and won merit in repeated battles.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Yuan, Liu Qian, Ma Huaide, and Fan Ke all served on the western frontier and won distinction in repeated battles.

sentences.zh: 其初起自卒伍，而能練習民事、招輯散亡，不獨一武夫而已。

translations.literal: Though they first rose from the ranks, they could attend to civilian affairs and gather the scattered and lost—not merely martial men alone.
translations.idiomatic: Though they rose from the ranks, they could handle civilian affairs and resettle the displaced—not mere fighting men alone.

sentences.zh: 趙振挽強命中，精曉兵機。

translations.literal: Zhao Zhen drew the strong bow and hit the mark; he was finely versed in military opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zhen was unmatched with the heavy bow and finely versed in military strategy.

sentences.zh: 塞門之敗，振擁兵不救，何獨暗於此邪？

translations.literal: At the defeat at Saimen, Zhen held troops and did not rescue—why was he alone blind in this?
translations.idiomatic: Yet at the defeat at Saimen he held back his troops and did not rescue the garrison—why was he alone so blind in that matter?

sentences.zh: 」子珣年少習書史，閱武技，用兵以來，人以為無如珣者。

translations.literal: " His son Xun in youth studied books and histories and reviewed martial arts; since troops were used, people thought none equaled Xun.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xun studied history and the classics in his youth and trained in martial arts. Since the war began, people considered him without equal.

sentences.zh: 籠竿一戰，西人奔走不暇，從容而拔劉滬於死，英風義烈，何可少哉！

translations.literal: At the battle of Longgan, the westerners fled without leisure; calmly he extricated Liu Hu from death—heroic wind and righteous fervor, how could one slight this!
translations.idiomatic: At the battle of Longgan the westerners fled in disorder, yet he calmly rescued Liu Hu from death. His heroic spirit and righteous daring—how could one slight such a man!

sentences.zh: 葛懷敏以不用珣計而取敗，珣亦力戰而沒，惜哉！

translations.literal: Ge Huaimin because he did not use Xun's plan met defeat; Xun also fought fiercely and perished—alas!
translations.idiomatic: Ge Huaimin was defeated because he ignored Xun's counsel, and Xun too fought to the end and perished. What a pity!

sentences.zh: 安俊、向寶無多戰功，夏人皆識其名而畏之。

translations.literal: An Jun and Xiang Bao had not many battle achievements, yet the Xia people all knew their names and feared them.
translations.idiomatic: An Jun and Xiang Bao won few great victories, yet the Xia all knew their names and feared them.

sentences.zh: 張忠區區，較之諸人，未可同日語也。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhong was petty; compared with these men, he cannot be spoken of in the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhong was a minor figure who cannot be mentioned in the same breath as these men.
